input.expense: Team dinner on Thursday for 4 engineers at a steakhouse after the release. Included two bottles of wine. Total $412, paid on my personal card, receipt attached. No client was present.
input.policy: Meals: Team meals are reimbursable when approved in advance by the manager and when they mark a project milestone. Alcohol is reimbursable only at client-facing events. Meals over $75 per person require a manager's written approval before submission. Receipts are required for any expense over $25.
